::: {#thm-log-loss-slope}

#### The slope of the soft rule's log loss

The mean [log loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-log-loss) $\emprisk$ of the [soft 0-or-1 rule](ml-review.qmd#exr-log-loss-curve) has derivative

$$
\dif{\emprisk}{\param} = \avgin (\outvar_i - \hprob_i)
$$

with respect to its cutoff $\param$.

:::

::: proof
By @sol-log-loss-slope.
The rule is a [logistic regression](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#def-logistic-regression) whose coefficient on $\predvar$ is fixed at 1 and whose intercept is $-\param$,
so the formula is also minus the intercept component of [lds's gradient of the log loss](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/logistic-regression.html#thm-logistic-gradient),
divided by $\nobs$ to give the mean.
:::
